Strategy: Moderate-bin preference. Prefer bins whose residual is at most twice the item, choosing the roomiest among them; bins roomier than that rank like Best Fit and only win if no moderate bin exists. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit is moderate but a roomier moderate bin exists. It may help by preserving both the tightest slot and very roomy bins, but may fail if the moderate bins it uses were needed for later medium items.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [r if r <= 2 * item else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Moderate-bin preference: roomiest bin with residual <= 2*item wins, roomier bins rank Best Fit.
